page.title: Watcharr Scrobbler
page.subtitle: Scrobble Netflix, Prime Video & Jellyfin → Watcharr

settings.urlHint: The base URL of your self-hosted Watcharr instance (without /api).
settings.passwordHint: The password is sent only once to log in to Watcharr. Only the returned token is stored.
settings.scrobblingHint: Automatically add movies/shows from Netflix, Prime Video and Jellyfin to Watcharr.
settings.thresholdHint: When a movie or episode reaches this progress, it is marked as watched (FINISHED) in Watcharr.
settings.historyHint: Opens the history page with service ↔ Watcharr comparison, match correction, and selective import.
settings.step1: Open Netflix, Prime Video or your Jellyfin server and start a movie or series.
settings.step2: The add-on detects the title, season, and episode from the service's player or metadata API.
settings.step3: It searches for the title via your Watcharr instance (TMDB ID) and adds it to your watchlist (WATCHING).
settings.step4Before: Once a movie/episode has been watched to ≥
settings.behaviourHint: You can adjust the behavior at any time via the popup or this page.
settings.footer: Data processing happens locally and only with your own Watcharr instance. No data is transferred to third parties.
settings.notConfigured: Your Watcharr connection is not configured yet.
settings.jellyfinHint: Log in with your Jellyfin credentials. Your Watcharr server must have the Jellyfin host configured.
settings.plexHint: A popup will open at plex.tv where you log in and grant access. Your Watcharr server must have the Plex host configured.
settings.plexClosed: The Plex login window was closed.
settings.plexTimeout: Plex login timed out – please try again.
settings.plexPopupBlocked: Could not open the Plex popup. Please allow popups for this page.
settings.jellyfinUrlHint: Base URL of your Jellyfin server (e.g. http://192.168.1.10:8096). Log in to Jellyfin in this browser – the extension uses that session, so no separate login or API key is needed.
settings.jellyfinInvalid: That does not look like a valid http(s) URL – please enter the base URL of your Jellyfin server.

error.noToken: The server returned no login token.

popup.noService: Open Netflix, Prime Video or Jellyfin and start a movie or series – the popup will then show the progress.
popup.notConfiguredDetail: Connect your Watcharr instance in the settings.

toolbar.openService: Open Netflix, Prime Video or Jellyfin

history.title: Watcharr Scrobbler – History
history.switchProviderTitle: History from {service}. Click to switch to {target}.
history.loadFileTitle: Import a previously exported history file (CSV or JSON) into Watcharr.
history.fileReadFailed: The file could not be read: {error}
history.oldestFirstTitle: Loads the complete history once and sorts oldest → newest.
history.matchExactTitle: Matching: date and time must match.
history.matchRoughTitle: Matching: only checks whether the episode is already watched/finished.
history.orderConfirmText: To list the oldest entries at the top, the complete viewing history is loaded once and sorted oldest → newest. For a very large history, this initial load can take a moment and triggers many requests.
history.dataTitle: Export the history or import a history file
history.exportText: The complete viewing history is loaded once and written to a file. For a very large history this can take a moment and triggers many requests. Nothing is imported into Watcharr.
history.exportFileMode: Export is only available for the service history, not for an imported file.
history.exportEnrichHint: Every entry is matched against TMDB through your Watcharr instance (TMDB ID, type, title, year) – these columns make the file easy to import into other services.
history.exportNoWatcharr: Watcharr is not connected, so no TMDB data can be added. The file is exported with the raw service data only.
history.exportDoneEnriched: {count} entries exported, {matched} with TMDB data ({unmatched} without).
history.exportTruncated: {count} entries exported – the safety limit of the load stopped the export; the history may contain more entries.
history.titlesLoaded: {total} titles loaded. Scroll to load more.
history.searchHint: Enter search term, then select match.
history.noServiceTab: Open {services} in a tab and log in, then reload this page.
history.needPermission: Watcharr Scrobbler is not allowed to read {service} yet. Click "Reload" to grant access.
history.permissionBlocked: The browser did not grant access to {service}. Allow it in about:addons → Watcharr Scrobbler → Permissions, then reload this page.
history.primeVideoNote: Sign in with the same account on Prime Video AND on Amazon. The history is fetched through both sessions – if different accounts are logged in there, the history is incomplete or belongs to another account.
history.badgeReaddTitle: Already finished in Watcharr, but not for this date – importing adds this watch date.

error.notConfigured: Watcharr is not configured. Please log in through the settings first.
error.noServiceTab: No open {service} tab found. Open {service} and log in.
error.serviceTabPrepare: The {service} tab could not be prepared. Please reload the {service} page and try again. ({reason})
error.hostPermission: No access to {service}. Reload the {service} page once and try again. ({reason})
error.networkBlocked: The {service} API could not be reached because the extension is not allowed to access it. Click "Reload" to grant access.
error.networkBlockedOrigin: The {service} API could not be reached: the browser blocks {origin}. Click "Reload" to grant access.
error.serviceNotConfigured: No server URL is configured for {service} yet. Add it in the settings.
error.noResponse: No response from the service tab received.
error.authFailed: Authentication failed – please log in again.
error.createFailed: Create failed (no watched ID in the response).
error.historyBusy: The history is currently being loaded. Please try again in a moment.
error.fileUnreadable: The file could not be read. CSV or JSON is expected.
error.fileEmpty: The file contains no usable entries.
error.tmdbNotFound: The TMDB data from the file was not found in Watcharr – please pick the match manually.
error.jellyfinNotLoggedIn: No Jellyfin login found. Please log in to Jellyfin in this browser and reload the page.
error.jellyfinUnavailable: The Jellyfin server could not be reached.
error.jellyfinApiFailed: The Jellyfin API returned an error.
